source: NACA TN 3344, Figures 3(a) and 4(b), highest heat-transfer run Re_D=2.28e6
selection: Human visual selection of symbol centers; approximate digitization, not original tabulated measurements

heat.abscissa: meridional arc length s / diameter D
heat.ordinate: local Nu_s / sqrt(Re_s); not freestream Re_D and not heat flux W/m2

wallTemperature.selectedSymbol: upper heated-body triangles; Re_D=2.28e6; exclude lower unheated-body data
wallTemperature.abscissa: meridional arc length s / diameter D
wallTemperature.ordinate: heated surface temperature / freestream total temperature
wallTemperature.nearZeroCoordinateRule: The nose symbol is centered on the y-axis; set first s/D to exactly zero and retain raw pixel coordinate separately
